workspace.analysis.label: Analysis status
workspace.analysis.analysingStale: The results shown belong to the model before the last change.
workspace.analysis.analysedHelp: The time from sending the model to the analysis worker until its answer arrived. The first analysis after the page opens includes starting the worker.
workspace.analysis.issuesCount: {count, plural, one {The model has # issue and is not analysed. See Issues in the side panel.} other {The model has # issues and is not analysed. See Issues in the side panel.}}
workspace.analysis.unstableUx: The structure is unstable. The analysis stopped where it found the structure free to move along X at node {node}.
workspace.analysis.unstableUy: The structure is unstable. The analysis stopped where it found the structure free to move along Y at node {node}.
workspace.analysis.unstableUz: The structure is unstable. The analysis stopped where it found the structure free to move along Z at node {node}.
workspace.analysis.unstableRx: The structure is unstable. The analysis stopped where it found the structure free to rotate about X at node {node}.
workspace.analysis.unstableRy: The structure is unstable. The analysis stopped where it found the structure free to rotate about Y at node {node}.
workspace.analysis.unstableRz: The structure is unstable. The analysis stopped where it found the structure free to rotate about Z at node {node}.
workspace.analysis.unstableHint: That node is where the check stopped, not always the cause. Look for a missing support or restraint, or for a part that is not connected to the rest.
workspace.analysis.unstablePlanar: The model lies in one X-Z plane and not every node is held out of that plane. If it is meant as a plane frame, this may be the cause:
workspace.analysis.unsupportedTruss: {more, plural, =0 {Truss members are not analysed yet: {members}.} other {Truss members are not analysed yet: {members} and # more.}}
workspace.analysis.unsupportedRelease: {more, plural, =0 {Members with end releases are not analysed yet: {members}.} other {Members with end releases are not analysed yet: {members} and # more.}}
workspace.analysis.overflow: A number of the model or of its result is too large to compute with. Check the values of the sections, the materials and the loads.
workspace.analysis.failedWorker: The analysis worker could not be started, or it stopped with an error.
workspace.analysis.failedSolve: The solver stopped with an error.
workspace.analysis.failedSend: The model could not be sent to the analysis worker.
workspace.analysis.lostAccuracy: Warning: the result may have lost accuracy. The stiffness terms of the model differ very much (smallest pivot ratio {ratio}).

workspace.results.reactionsHelp: What each support applies to the structure, in global axes.
workspace.results.displacementHelp: Global axes. Translations in mm, rotations in rad.
workspace.results.noNodeResult: No result for this node yet.
workspace.results.endForcesHelp: The forces and moments the joints apply to the two ends of the member, in the member's local axes (x runs from the start node to the end node), positive along and about the positive axes at both ends. They are not the values of an internal force diagram: the same axial force or moment has opposite signs at the two ends.
